_comment: Row 797. The session keeper's authentication callback must still reach the login implementation: if the callback stops calling do_login, no attempt is spent and the accounting denominator silently shrinks. The regex matches only the dotted callable name; the arguments stay in a lookahead so no policy value is frozen into the anchor.
subject: session keeper authentication still invokes the login implementation
